:::{#def-surprisal-continuous}
#### Surprisal of a value of a continuous random variable

The **surprisal** of a possible value $x$ of a
[continuous random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-continuous-rv) $X$
with [probability density function](random-variables.qmd#def-pdf) $\p(X=x)$
and $\p(X=x) > 0$ is

$$\surprisalf{x} \eqdef -\log \p(X=x).$$

This extends the [surprisal](#def-surprisal) of a value of a [discrete random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-discrete-rv),
with the [density](random-variables.qmd#def-pdf) in place of the [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability).

:::
